title: What If You Could Taste Words?
description:
Someone says your name and you taste strawberries. Someone says "Monday" and your mouth fills with burnt toast. For some people this is real: it's called synesthesia, and the rarest kind lets you taste words. Here's what life would be like if every word had a flavor, the man who says the name Derek tastes like earwax, and a quick test that shows your brain blends your senses too.

What would your name taste like? Tell me in the comments 👇

▶ More What Ifs: What If You Saw the World in Slow Motion Like a Fly?
